questions.explanation: 'Was going to' expresses a past plan for the future.
questions.q: She ___ start her new job the following Monday.

questions.explanation: Reported promises about the future use 'would', not 'will'.
questions.q: He promised he ___ help us move house.

questions.explanation: A future seen from a past reporting moment uses 'would'.
options: They said they will arrive at noon.
They said they arrive at noon.
They said they would arrive at noon.
They said they are arriving at noon.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: 'Were about to' describes an imminent past action that was interrupted.
questions.q: We ___ about to leave when the phone rang.

questions.explanation: Predictions made in the past about the future use 'would'.
questions.q: I had a feeling the negotiations ___ collapse.

questions.explanation: 'Would' expresses the future as seen from a past plan.
questions.q: The original plan was that the bridge ___ open in 2020.

questions.explanation: The change of mind happened in the past, so use the past simple.
questions.q: She was going to apply, but she ___ her mind.

questions.explanation: 'Would' shows a future consequence viewed from the past.
questions.q: Little did they know the decision ___ haunt them for years.

questions.explanation: 'Was going to' marks an unfulfilled past intention.
questions.q: He ___ to be a doctor, but ended up in finance.

questions.explanation: 'Be about to' is followed by the bare infinitive.
options: I was about to calling him when he arrived.
I am about to called him when he arrived.
I was about to call him when he arrived.
I was about to called him when he arrived.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: 'Were going to get' expresses the cancelled past plan.
questions.q: They ___ married in June, but the wedding was cancelled.

questions.explanation: A past forecast about the future is reported with 'would'.
questions.q: The forecast said it ___ rain later.

questions.explanation: 'Knew' sets the viewpoint in the past, so the future becomes 'would be'.
questions.q: She knew the exam ___ difficult.

questions.explanation: 'Was to' expresses a past arrangement for the future.
questions.q: He ___ to hand in his resignation the next day, but changed his mind.

questions.explanation: After past 'thought', the future must be 'would', not 'will'.
options: She said she would call later.
We were going to visit them that weekend.
They were about to board when the announcement came.
He thought the train will be late.
questions.q: Find the sentence with a mistake.

questions.explanation: Predictions made in the past use 'would' for the future.
questions.q: By 1990, experts predicted, robots ___ do all household chores.

questions.explanation: 'Was going to' expresses an unfulfilled past intention.
questions.q: I ___ to tell you yesterday, but you left early.

questions.explanation: 'Would be' reports a future obligation from a past document.
questions.q: The letter stated that payment ___ due within 30 days.

questions.explanation: 'Would + infinitive' can describe a habitual past action.
options: He will visit his grandmother every Sunday as a child.
He is going to visit his grandmother every Sunday as a child.
He would visited his grandmother every Sunday as a child.
He would visit his grandmother every Sunday as a child.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: Future developments viewed from the past take 'would'.
questions.q: Nobody imagined the small startup ___ become a tech giant.

topic: Future in the past (was going to / would)
